meta.title: CACEIS Human Capital AI Command Center
meta.subtitle: Evolved prototype for HRBP prioritization, segmentation, and next-best-action planning

kpis.label: Employees in scope
kpis.detail: Anonymized employee profiles available to the prototype

kpis.label: High absence alerts
kpis.detail: Employees currently scored in the high-risk band

kpis.label: Review coverage
kpis.detail: Share of employees with a completed review flag

kpis.label: Avg modeled upside
kpis.detail: Average gain in high-performer probability under recommended actions

kpis.label: No-training exposure
kpis.detail: Share of employees with zero recorded training hours

absence_risk.label: Absence risk prediction
absence_risk.objective: Predict employees likely to exceed 30 absence days.

performance_uplift.label: Performance opportunity model
performance_uplift.objective: Estimate who could move closer to high-performer benchmarks after review and training interventions.

segments.description: Large population with low training exposure, low absence, and limited formal review activity.
Employees already engaged in the review process and positioned for targeted development.
Highly trained employees with elevated absence pressure and strong review coverage.
Long-tenure employees with stable performance but low recent capability refresh.
